text: Figure 7.2: Transformer Example for Intra-ECU Communication The shown intra-ECU transformer is used for converting different representations of data structures between the NvBlockSwComponentType and the DCM. In general transformers have to specify their output format to enable remote ECUs or hardware-dependent BSW modules to correctly work with the transformed data. For that, the serialized (on-wire) format has to be fixed. Note: Please be aware that AUTOSAR currently doesn’t specify any transformer which only marshalls the payload and adds no header in front. ransformerGeneral
